answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 5574 Country: India Title: Can we donate the sum of the Bank?s interest to construct the toilet or bathroom in the Mosque? Please give me appropriate answer. Question: Can we donate the sum of the Bank?s interest to construct the toilet or bathroom in the Mosque? Please give me appropriate answer. Answer ID: 5574 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 165/165=M) No. It is unlawful to use interest amount of bank in construction of toilets and bathrooms for a mosque. Such interest money should only be distributed among needy and destitute people without any intention of reward, as it is mentioned in Shami : سبیل الکسب الخبیث التصدق اذا تعذر الرد علی صاحبہ الخ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
